items.informal_name: Positivity Evaluation for Triangle Removal Bound
items.informal_description: A meta-programming tactic that checks the positivity of the triangle removal bound $\triangleRemovalBound \varepsilon$ in the real numbers. When applied to a real-valued triangle removal bound expression, it verifies strict positivity of the parameter $\varepsilon$ using positivity checks, normalization, and hypothesis analysis, returning a certified positive strictness level or failing if the bound does not match the expected form.

items.informal_name: Identity Function is Component-wise Less Than or Equal to Step Bound in Szemerédi's Regularity Lemma
items.informal_description: The identity function is component-wise less than or equal to the step bound function $ n \mapsto n \times 4^n $ in Szemerédi's regularity lemma, meaning that for every natural number $ n $, $ n \leq n \times 4^n $.

items.informal_name: Upper Bound on Minimum Parts by Initial Bound in Szemerédi's Regularity Lemma
items.type: ∀ (ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ), l ≤ SzemerediRegularity.initialBound ε l
items.informal_description: For any positive real number $\varepsilon$ and natural number $l$, the value of $l$ is less than or equal to the initial bound defined as $\max\left(7, \max\left(l, \left\lfloor \frac{\log(100 / \varepsilon^5)}{\log 4} \right\rfloor + 1\right)\right)$ in Szemerédi's regularity lemma.

items.informal_name: Minimum Partition Size Bound in Szemerédi's Regularity Lemma
items.type: ∀ (ε : ℝ) (l : ℕ), l ≤ SzemerediRegularity.bound ε l
items.informal_description: For any positive real number $\varepsilon$ and natural number $l$, the minimum partition size $l$ satisfies $l \leq \text{bound}(\varepsilon, l)$, where $\text{bound}(\varepsilon, l)$ is the tower-type bound defined as $\left(\text{stepBound}^{\left\lfloor 4/\varepsilon^5 \right\rfloor_+} (\text{initialBound}(\varepsilon, l))\right) \times 16^{\left(\text{stepBound}^{\left\lfloor 4/\varepsilon^5 \right\rfloor_+} (\text{initialBound}(\varepsilon, l))\right)}$. Here, $\text{initialBound}(\varepsilon, l) = \max\left(7, \max\left(l, \left\lfloor \frac{\log(100/\varepsilon^5)}{\log 4} \right\rfloor + 1\right)\right)$ and $\text{stepBound}(n) = n \times 4^n$.
